metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent exited the email setup wizard via 'Use Thunderbird without email account', then manually added SMTP server only, leaving no incoming mail accounts configured.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can skip incoming email setup in Thunderbird wizard, navigate directly to Outgoing Server (SMTP) settings, add SMTP server without creating an incoming account.
metadata.explanation: Task checks: (1) at least one SMTP server is configured in prefs.js (0.4), (2) no incoming accounts (imap/pop3) are configured in prefs.js (0.4), and (3) the SMTP username matches anonym-x2024@outlook.com (0.2). Blank profile starts with no SMTP or incoming accounts, so it gets 0.4 credit initially—agent must add SMTP to get full score. [Fixed: evaluator.func was missing the check_ prefix; corrected to check_thunderbird_smtp_no_incoming__f562ce0912b384f5748be41ba253880a]
fix_history: Fix 1: Updated evaluator.func from 'thunderbird_smtp_no_incoming__f562ce0912b384f5748be41ba253880a' to 'check_thunderbird_smtp_no_incoming__f562ce0912b384f5748be41ba253880a' — metric function name in the file has the check_ prefix which was missing in the JSON func field.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads prefs.js to extract all required state: SMTP presence (mail.smtpservers), incoming account types (mail.server.serverN.type), and SMTP username (mail.smtpserver.serverN.username).

Metric checks all three instruction requirements: (1) at least one SMTP server configured (+0.4), (2) no incoming IMAP/POP3 accounts (+0.4), (3) SMTP username matches anonym-x2024@outlook.com (+0.2). Scoring sums to 1.0.
Expected parameter handling is correct for type='rule': metric accesses expected.get('expected_has_smtp') etc. directly, which is correct since the framework passes the rules dict as 'expected'.
Postconfig kills Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring all settings are flushed to disk — necessary and correct approach.
Bash fallback in getter (find /home/user/.thunderbird -name prefs.js) handles cases where the hardcoded profile path 6ex3j72p.default-release does not match the actual profile directory.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The hardcoded prefs.js path '6ex3j72p.default-release' may not match the blank profile's actual directory name; the existing bash fallback mitigates this, but it could be made primary for robustness.
